description: This Fourth of July carries extraordinary meaning as our nation celebrates 250 years of freedom. Across America — and certainly throughout District 33 — families are gathering with joy, pride, and excitement. From backyard barbecues to fireworks lighting up the night sky, we are united by our love for this country and our gratitude for the privilege of living in the greatest nation on earth.
